intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Orientation day. A help desk on the main quad, piled with maps and tea. The person behind it waves you over.

hello.speaker: python
hello.text: Oh, you're new? Don't worry. I'm Monty. Here, everything just needs to line up nicely, and we'll get along fine.

teach.speaker: python
teach.text: Every programmer starts the same way: by saying hello to the world. In Python, that's one line.

passed.speaker: python
passed.text: There it is. Beautiful is better than ugly, and that was beautiful. Welcome to Runtime, {player}.

failed.speaker: python
failed.text: Hm. Not quite. It's okay! Want to try again?

bye.speaker: python
bye.text: No rush. The help desk is open all day.
